title: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.14709v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in applications that act on users' long-term behavior histories, from personal assistants to recommendation and advertising systems. These applications demand the user dimension of LLM intelligence: inferring a person's preferences, intent, and likely future actions from weeks to years of behavior data. Yet current models are trained on static text or synthetic data, neither of which captures how user behavior evolves over time. Real-world behavior records, already available at scale on content platforms and in personal-assistant agents, offer a natural supervisory signal. We propose user behavior as supervision and introduce Vela, a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories. translated_title: Vela：以用户行为作为监督激发大语言模型智能
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正越来越多地被部署在基于用户长期行为历史进行操作的应用中，涵盖个人助手、推荐系统和广告系统等领域。这些应用需要大语言模型智能中的“用户维度”：即从数周乃至数年的行为数据中推断一个人的偏好、意图以及可能的未来行动。然而，当前的模型都是在静态文本或合成数据上训练的，两者都无法捕捉用户行为随时间的演变方式。真实世界的行为记录——已经在内容平台和个人助手智能体中大规模存在——恰好提供了一种天然的监督信号。我们提出将用户行为作为监督，并介绍了Vela，一个能够将真实用户行为数据转化为可训练任务和轨迹的框架。基于100,000名用户的匿名化行为记录，Vela在91个真实世界任务模板上生成了100,000个任务；基于难度的过滤和轨迹接受……
tldr: 该论文提出“用户行为作为监督”的新方法，并推出Vela框架，将真实用户行为数据转化为可训练的任务和轨迹，从而使大语言模型能够从长期行为历史中推断用户偏好、意图和未来行动。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes "user behavior as supervision" and introduces Vela, a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories, enabling LLMs to infer user preferences, intents, and future actions from long-term behavior histories.
